title: Parts of the Body
summary: Learn basic words for parts of the human body. You will be able to talk about your face, arms, and legs.

sections.p: Let us start at the top! You have one head. On your face, you have two eyes to see and one nose to smell. You also have a mouth to speak and eat. We use these words every day when we talk about how we look or feel.

ex.mean: The color of my two eyes is blue.
Please show the inside of your mouth.
I have pain in my head.

sections.p: Next, let us look at the middle of your body. You have two arms. At the end of each arm, you have a hand. On your hands, you have fingers. You use your hands and fingers to write, hold things, and say hello!

ex.en: Wash your hands before you eat.
ex.mean: Clean your hands with water and soap.

ex.en: She has a ring on her finger.
ex.mean: There is a ring around one of her fingers.

sections.p: Finally, we have legs and feet. You have two legs to stand, walk, and run. At the bottom of each leg, you have a foot. When you have two of them, we call them feet. You put shoes on your feet.

ex.en: My legs are tired from walking.
ex.mean: I walked a lot, so my legs need rest.

ex.en: Put your shoes on your feet.

tip: Point to your body parts as you say the English words out loud. Moving your body helps your brain remember new words faster!

quiz.ask: Choose the correct word for seeing.
quiz.en: I look at the picture with my ___.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct word for the plural of foot.
quiz.en: I wear shoes on my two ___.
I write my name with a pen in my ___.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct word for smelling food.
quiz.en: I smell the nice soup with my ___.
I wear a hat on my ___.

quiz.ask: Choose the correct body part for walking.
quiz.en: I use my two ___ to walk to the store.
